ashtheslowone: After 11 days of war, P-F6 had a place for everything. On Day 11, the men rearranged a shelf to make a place for Ivo "Ash" Ashtheslowon. The Hegemony flag went up over Grey Mill. Ivo "Ash" Ashtheslowon did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.
Officers came to inspect P-F6. Ivo "Ash" Ashtheslowon polished his buttons with mud, which is the only polish there is.
Ivo "Ash" Ashtheslowon counted three seconds after the enemy flare went out, then fired at the spot where it had shown a face. Bram Des was grazed.
Ivo "Ash" Ashtheslowon and Konrad "Bones" Dominushospe carried a kettle through three narrow turns without spilling a drop. The applause at the end caused the accident.
Ivo "Ash" Ashtheslowon stood at the parapet at dawn with the rest of P-F6, bayonet fixed, staring into the grey. Nothing came. Nothing came yesterday, either.
A bullet went through Ivo "Ash" Ashtheslowon's sleeve at P-F6 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Roland Kahuna of the Concord (@kahuna382000).
Ivo "Ash" Ashtheslowon was put on light duty at P-F6: peeling potatoes, sorting mail, and complaining.
blacksmithsbenchstudios: The sergeant gave Leopold "Mole" Blacksmithsb a dead man's blanket and a living man's job. That is how replacements start, on Day 10 or any other.

Leopold "Mole" Blacksmithsb was hit in the foot through his boot at U-F13. The boot had to be cut off. He asked them to save the other one. Shot by Cyril Drawtoss of the Hegemony (@drawtoss). A rifle cracked from the far side of no man's land. Leopold "Mole" Blacksmithsb fell at U-F13 and never moved again. Shot by Cyril Drawtoss of the Hegemony (@drawtoss).

Viktor Blacksmithsb put a pressed cornflower beside the bunk. Someone who had known Leopold "Mole" Blacksmithsb helped clear the shelf without saying why. The Hegemony hold Grey Mill now, and they can see straight into U-F13. Viktor Blacksmithsb has learned to walk bent double.
Viktor Blacksmithsb raised his head for a heartbeat too long at U-F13. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Walter "Bones" Marko of the Hegemony (@albert_marko_).
A single shot from across the wire hit Viktor Blacksmithsb in the thigh at U-F13. He crawled the last yards on his elbows. Shot by Teodor Fleming of the Hegemony (@lachie_fleming1).
Viktor Blacksmithsb spent the day on a stretcher counting the bearers who went past. Forty-three. None of them stopped.
For days Viktor Blacksmithsb was too weak to sit up on the stretcher. This morning he sat up, then stood, then asked for his rifle.

A bullet hit the sandbag next to Viktor Blacksmithsb's ear at U-F13 and sprayed his face with grit and blood. A scratch, the medic said, and a lucky one. Shot by Bram Jackalaaltos of the Hegemony (@jackalaaltosfritz). The order came down the line: anything that moves. Something moved. Viktor Blacksmithsb fired, and Konrad "Button" Sneakysnakem was grazed.

A bullet struck Viktor Blacksmithsb below the ribs at U-F13. He kept asking whether the post was still manned until the bearers took him away. Shot by Walter "Bones" Marko of the Hegemony (@albert_marko_). The bearers reached Viktor Blacksmithsb at U-F13 too late. One shot, and it was over. Shot by Walter "Bones" Marko of the Hegemony (@albert_marko_).
Dietrich "Hollow" Blacksmithsb asked about Viktor Blacksmithsb on arriving at U-F13. The first story concerned a stolen breakfast. He asked for another.
door.matt3555: Day 10. The corporal put Felix "Parson" Matt beside a veteran and said to copy everything except the language.

Felix "Parson" Matt measured a replacement beam three times in the narrow passage. Nobody wanted to be the one who got it wrong. The Hegemony won Grey Mill. In V-F11, Felix "Parson" Matt listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.
Felix "Parson" Matt and Clement Gagulaa share one pair of good gloves on watch, one glove each. It is not practical. It is friendship.
Felix "Parson" Matt got a photo of the family house. He spent longer looking at the strange curtains than at the faces.
Wiring party. Felix "Parson" Matt held the coil while two others pulled. Twenty yards of new wire at V-F11, and everyone came back.
Felix "Parson" Matt of the Concord and Jakub Marshall of the Hegemony have been shooting at the same tin can on the wire at the Hanging Bridge for a week. Both trenches keep score.

Felix "Parson" Matt was on the dawn watch at V-F11 when the Hegemony raiders came. A club, a shout, and Felix "Parson" Matt was on the trench floor waiting for the medic. Raider: Jonas Quazzii of the Hegemony (@quazzii_7).
Felix "Parson" Matt's wound turned bad. The bandage was not enough and he was carried back to wait for a bed.
foad666x: The sergeant gave Gustav Foad a dead man's blanket and a living man's job. That is how replacements start, on Day 9 or any other.
On Day 10, Blackwater Canal passed to the Hegemony. Gustav Foad wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.

Gustav Foad fired at a movement across the wire at S-C2. The man went down: Karel Lynallwarrio, badly wounded. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Gustav Foad is number 868. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Grey Mill. Gustav Foad folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.
Nils Gregoriousdo taught Gustav Foad three words in the language of home. Gustav uses all three at the wrong moment, every day.
A rat has started sitting on the ammunition box next to Gustav Foad's bunk. He has named it Duchess.
A football came over the parapet from the Hegemony side with Gustav Foad's name scratched on it. Gideon Sam kicked it back. It did not come again.
Duchess the rat now waits for Gustav Foad at dawn watch every morning. He shares crumbs with it. The corporal calls this desertion of rations.
The new recruit kept closing both eyes to aim. Gustav Foad spent the afternoon helping until one eye stayed open.
Duchess ran squealing out of the dugout at three in the morning. Gustav Foad followed, cursing, seconds before a shell came through the roof. He owes Duchess his life.
gremlin_boi32: Valentin "Button" Boi came up on Day 9 carrying news from Northwick. A man interrupted to ask whether the railway clock had been repaired.

An enemy soldier was using the same gap in the parapet every morning to empty a pot of tea. This morning Valentin "Button" Boi was waiting. Cyril "Crow" Trevor was gravely wounded. A shell burst over R-C9 and Valentin "Button" Boi went down with a leg that would not hold him. The stretcher bearers came at a run. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Blackwater Canal. Valentin "Button" Boi read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.

The bearers moved Valentin "Button" Boi's stretcher against the wall at midday and back again at dusk. That was the whole schedule. The clerk counted the names twice. Valentin "Button" Boi is number 621 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. Day 11: Grey Mill was lost. Valentin "Button" Boi wrote down the news without trying to explain it.
A medic stopped by Valentin "Button" Boi's stretcher every few hours for a week. Today the medic found it empty. Valentin "Button" Boi had gone back to R-C9.
Valentin "Button" Boi got a letter from Marguerite. Two pages, one of them only about the weather back home. He read that page most.
Valentin "Button" Boi fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Quentin Zanetaylor, grazed. Nobody nearby said anything.
Valentin "Button" Boi moved his hide three times today. Snipers who stay in one place do not stay anywhere for long.
A tin cup glinted on the enemy parapet. Valentin "Button" Boi aimed just below it. Edmund Check was gravely wounded.
Two shots, one miss. The second found Marek Ditrih, grazed. Valentin "Button" Boi cut a small notch in the rifle stock and then wished he had not.
hect_fr1: The sergeant gave Valentin Hect a dead man's blanket and a living man's job. That is how replacements start, on Day 9 or any other.
Blackwater Canal is lost. Valentin Hect heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.

A bullet grazed Valentin Hect's ribs at R-C3. He found the hole in his coat first and the wound second. Shot by Emil "Shadow" Ronnnie of the Hegemony (@scrawny_ronnnie). Valentin Hect did not want to shoot today. Then the enemy shot first, and Valentin Hect fired back. Tobias Lilmaggs was grazed. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Valentin Hect answered to number 766. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Valentin Hect kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.
Valentin Hect returned to R-C3 with a fresh bandage and orders to keep it dry. He has already broken the second part.
Valentin Hect and the spotter took turns with the telescope for half a day, talking only in numbers. At the last number Valentin Hect fired. Teodor Bangarang was badly wounded.
Valentin Hect began repairing a blanket with scraps from ruined clothing. The first patch is a different colour from everything else.
Valentin Hect fired at the flash of a shovel across the wire. Behind the shovel was Felix Kebapien, now badly wounded.
Valentin Hect moved to a new hide at R-C3 before dawn, because the old one had been too lucky. The first shot from the new one found Otto Bangarang, badly wounded.
Word of Valentin Hect's blanket spread. A strip of lining and a square from an old scarf arrived without explanation.
icespiceynoddlrs: Albin Icespiceynod, a clockmaker from Brennmoor, was sent forward on Day 9 to fill a gap in R-C3. The gap had a name once. Nobody says it.
Victory at Blackwater Canal. Albin Icespiceynod let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.

A tin cup glinted on the enemy parapet. Albin Icespiceynod aimed just below it. Edmund Bjl was badly wounded. A figure ran between two enemy trenches. Albin Icespiceynod aimed a step ahead and fired: Florian Wman, grazed. Albin Icespiceynod got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 799. The men who came later will ask about it. The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Grey Mill. Albin Icespiceynod folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.
Albin Icespiceynod held the mirror while Otto Baumann shaved. The arrangement survived the shaving but not the comments.
Albin Icespiceynod spent the day watching one loophole in the enemy line. At dusk a periscope rose in it. He let it go. Tomorrow.
A bullet bounced off the trench wall and caught Albin Icespiceynod across the shin at R-C3. It bled a lot and meant very little. Shot by Ulrich Porsche of the Concord (@porsche930tt).

A single shot from across the wire hit Albin Icespiceynod in the thigh at R-C3. He crawled the last yards on his elbows. Shot by Karel "Tin" Mearsiecat of the Concord (@mearsiecat). Albin Icespiceynod stood up to fix a loose sandbag at R-C3. He did not get to finish the job. Shot by Karel "Tin" Mearsiecat of the Concord (@mearsiecat).
Emil Icespiceynod asked about Albin Icespiceynod on arriving at R-C3. The first story concerned a stolen breakfast. He asked for another.
At R-C3 the men had a bet on who would hit something first. Emil Icespiceynod won the bet. Yann Joaotomas was grazed.
Emil Icespiceynod borrowed a serial novel from a newspaper bundle. The instalment ends with a locked door and a pistol shot. The next issue is missing.
idkvariable: By the time Bastian Idkvariable reached R-C15, the war was 9 days old and had its own habits. He learned the first one within the hour: keep your head down.
The Hegemony hold Blackwater Canal now, and they can see straight into R-C15. Bastian Idkvariable has learned to walk bent double.

Bastian Idkvariable won a gold tooth at cards from a lance corporal in R-C15. The lance corporal wants a rematch. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Bastian Idkvariable answered to number 694. Day 11: Grey Mill was lost. Bastian Idkvariable wrote down the news without trying to explain it.
Dawn watch. Bastian Idkvariable put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Benedikt Jewnipers, badly wounded.
A tin cup glinted on the enemy parapet. Bastian Idkvariable aimed just below it. Gideon "Mud" Cubes was grazed.
Quentin Cade pulled Bastian Idkvariable out of a flooded shell hole at the Bone Quarry. Neither has mentioned it since. Both remember.
Rematch. Bastian Idkvariable lost everything he won, plus a photograph gone soft at the edges. The whole dugout watched.
Bastian Idkvariable and Silas Ofieczkaares have a secret signal: two taps on the helmet means 'still here'. They use it every night after the flares go out.

Bastian Idkvariable fired at a movement across the wire at R-C15. The man went down: Albin Dilloncoll, badly wounded. Bastian Idkvariable was hit in the hip at R-C15. Two men dragged him along the trench floor to the nearest medic. Shot by Florian Joshbanaka of the Hegemony (@joshbanaka).
jro_se11: Lucien "Shadow" Jro arrived on Day 3 as a replacement. The men in R-F18 had been fighting for 2 days already and looked at his clean boots like a rumour from another world. Lucien "Shadow" Jro was named Hero of Verdel Ridge. Asked for a few words, he gave the names of the people who had helped.
Someone returned an empty pot polished with bread. Lucien "Shadow" Jro accepted it as a review.
Lucien "Shadow" Jro obtained a recipe for a steamed suet pudding. The instructions assume a kitchen, a steady fire and ingredients that do not arrive in sacks.

Lucien "Shadow" Jro tried a small batch of a steamed suet pudding. The bottom burned before the middle cooked. The tasting committee ate the edges and requested patience. News of the loss of Hill 304 reached R-F18 with the rations. Lucien "Shadow" Jro ate while listening to the revised orders.
Lucien "Shadow" Jro and Felix "Tin" Singh carved a chessboard into an ammunition box. The pieces are bullets, buttons and one very patient beetle.
Lucien "Shadow" Jro pulled Quentin "Shadow" Danny out of a flooded shell hole at Saint-Ash crossroads. Neither has mentioned it since. Both remember.

Lucien "Shadow" Jro was hit twice at R-F18, once in the leg and once in the side. The second wound is the bad one. Shot by Gideon "Mud" Cubes of the Hegemony (@sugar_cubes745). Lucien "Shadow" Jro was killed outright at R-F18, a single bullet from across the wire. Shot by Gideon "Mud" Cubes of the Hegemony (@sugar_cubes745).
Cyril "Brick" Jro took the same post at R-F18 where Lucien "Shadow" Jro stood. He found his uncle's initials carved in the wall and put his own beneath them.

A sniper's bullet hit Cyril "Brick" Jro at R-F18. The medics worked on him in the bottom of the trench and shouted for a stretcher. Shot by Gideon "Mud" Cubes of the Hegemony (@sugar_cubes745). Cyril "Brick" Jro was killed at R-F18 while passing a message along the trench. He never finished the sentence. Shot by Gideon "Mud" Cubes of the Hegemony (@sugar_cubes745).
The papers connected Isidor Jro to Cyril "Brick" Jro. The men took longer to learn Isidor Jro's own habits, but they made the effort.
The sergeant read out the order: Blackwater Canal has fallen, hold the line. Isidor Jro looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.

At the Ossuary Wood, Isidor Jro of the Concord and Bram Deposito of the Hegemony traded insults across the wire for an hour. By the end they were trading recipes. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Isidor Jro answered to number 194. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Isidor Jro stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores. The medal for Verdel Ridge finally came up the line. On Day 3, Lucien "Shadow" Jro was the hundredth man of the Concord, and with him the ridge was theirs. Lucien is gone now, and Cyril after him. The major pinned the medal on Isidor Jro: "It belongs to the family. Wear it for both of them."
Isidor Jro (Concord) and Dietrich Marcusho (Hegemony) were sent out to cut the other side's wire at the Ossuary Wood on the same night. They met in the middle and agreed to go home.
Isidor Jro took the long way round Grey Mill because the short way had a sniper on it. The long way had two.
Isidor Jro thought about a landlady who kept his room exactly as it was on sentry tonight, and the night felt a little shorter.

Isidor Jro felt a hard tug at his hip at R-F18. The bullet had cut through his belt and the skin under it. He tied the belt back together with string. Shot by Ulrich "Crow" Thomasvorder of the Hegemony (@thomasvordermann).

A bullet found Isidor Jro at R-F18, high in the shoulder. He went down hard and stayed down. Shot by Walter Davebowlton of the Hegemony (@davebowlton). The bearers reached Isidor Jro at R-F18 too late. One shot, and it was over. Shot by Walter Davebowlton of the Hegemony (@davebowlton).
Karel Jro came to the front because his cousin Isidor Jro never came home. He carries a dented harmonica.
A new recruit would not eat with the others. Karel Jro left a place at the end of the bench and said nothing about it.
lamorinda_lokshin: "You're late," said the corporal when Pavel Lokshin arrived on Day 16. "Everyone's late. Get a spade."

Listening post, three in the morning. Pavel Lokshin heard boots, then whispering, then nothing. Just a fox, the corporal said. He did not sleep afterwards. A letter came for Pavel Lokshin with a sketch of the kitchen at home. Pavel Lokshin pinned it to the dugout wall.
llsj_9huncho: Roland "Lucky" Huncho joined the replacements on Day 9. An old hand checked his pack straps before asking his name.
Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Roland "Lucky" Huncho helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.

Roland "Lucky" Huncho fired a single round through a crack in the enemy's steel plate, a gap no wider than a finger. Otto Saigohasegaw was grazed. Roland "Lucky" Huncho moved to a new hide at S-C9 before dawn, because the old one had been too lucky. The first shot from the new one found Tobias Noirangelfan, badly wounded. The clerk counted the names twice. Roland "Lucky" Huncho is number 769 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Roland "Lucky" Huncho helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.

Face blackened with soot, Roland "Lucky" Huncho spent the night in a shell hole out in front of the wire. At first light Florian Heffy was grazed. Roland "Lucky" Huncho wrote the range on the back of a ration card: 380 yards. Then Roland "Lucky" Huncho used it. Marek "Brick" Agiraffedog was grazed.
Roland "Lucky" Huncho noticed regular flashes from a crack in an old stone wall. The position looks obvious enough to make him suspicious.
Roland "Lucky" Huncho fired, worked the bolt, and fired again. Across the wire, Florian Heffy was grazed. Roland "Lucky" Huncho ate breakfast without a word.
Roland "Lucky" Huncho watched a crack in an old stone wall through another shift. The flash returns at the same angle, even when nothing else moves.
Roland "Lucky" Huncho and Gustav Heyyybigmike compared drawings of home. Both drawings included a kitchen table larger than the house.
A second observer helped Roland "Lucky" Huncho confirm the trick: a piece of glass, placed to draw fire. The real watching point must be elsewhere.
m.v.in: Edmund Mvin introduced himself as a butcher's boy from Brennmoor. The corporal repeated the name correctly. That helped more than the advice.

A bullet hit the sandbag next to Edmund Mvin's ear at U-F16 and sprayed his face with grit and blood. A scratch, the medic said, and a lucky one. Shot by Pavel "Shadow" Yarrito of the Hegemony (@joey_yarrito). Grey Mill is lost. Edmund Mvin heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.
Edmund Mvin stopped talking around midday. The medic took one look and called for a stretcher.
Edmund Mvin spent a week on a stretcher in the corridor of the aid post. Today he stood up, held the wall, and walked out to U-F16.
A parcel arrived tied with blue ribbon. Edmund Mvin gave the contents away and kept the ribbon to mark a page.
The men argued about whether fish sleep. Edmund Mvin said yes, and was told to explain how anyone could know.
Edmund Mvin lifted the trench periscope and found a spider across the mirror. For one startled second, the enemy seemed enormous.
The company barber offered a choice of haircuts. Edmund Mvin asked to see the second one. The barber laughed.
mustakimabdulwahab93: The new machine gunner is Yann Mustakimabdu, once a tram conductor from Northwick. The corporal asked if a tram conductor was any use in a trench. Yann Mustakimabdu said he would find out.
Yann Mustakimabdu tried to write home with gloves on. The address is readable. Everything else will need some imagination.
Yann Mustakimabdu swept the enemy parapet at U-F1 with one long burst. Dust jumped all along the sandbags. Edmund Edhi was grazed.

A bullet hit Yann Mustakimabdu in the neck at U-F1. The medic kept two fingers pressed on the wound all the way down the trench. Shot by Wendel "Smokes" Cwit of the Concord (@i_cwit). A rifle cracked from the far side of no man's land. Yann Mustakimabdu fell at U-F1 and never moved again. Shot by Wendel "Smokes" Cwit of the Concord (@i_cwit).
Norbert "Rabbit" Mustakimabdu asked about Yann Mustakimabdu on arriving at U-F1. The first story concerned a stolen breakfast. He asked for another.

During a lull at the Bone Quarry, Nils Mira called across from the Concord line. Norbert "Rabbit" Mustakimabdu answered from the Hegemony side with a perfect imitation of an officer. Both trenches went quiet.

Nobody heard the Concord raiders cut the wire. Norbert "Rabbit" Mustakimabdu only heard boots on the duckboards at U-F1, then nothing but pain. Raider: Silas "Whistle" Theophane of the Concord (@theophane_br).

A bullet struck Norbert "Rabbit" Mustakimabdu below the ribs at U-F1. He kept asking whether the post was still manned until the bearers took him away. Shot by Yann "Ash" Tons of the Concord (@tons355). Norbert "Rabbit" Mustakimabdu was killed at U-F1 while passing a message along the trench. He never finished the sentence. Shot by Yann "Ash" Tons of the Concord (@tons355).
Zeno Mustakimabdu joined U-F1 under the shadow of Norbert "Rabbit" Mustakimabdu's name. At the first roll call, the corporal used the right one.
new_niche_edge: "You're late," said the corporal when Zeno Edge arrived on Day 9. "Everyone's late. Get a spade."
From Blackwater Canal the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Zeno Edge wrote to an old neighbor who promised to keep his garden alive that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'

A letter reached Zeno Edge from Saint-Lune. The streets there still have names. He read them out loud, one by one. The sergeant read out the order: Grey Mill has fallen, hold the line. Zeno Edge looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.
Zeno Edge was sent to examine a pump that worked only when struck. He asked the men to stop striking it long enough to listen.
Zeno Edge wrote to an old neighbor who promised to keep his garden alive. He did not mention the shelling. He mentioned the stars.
Henrik Tobiasweighi and Zeno Edge made a pact on sentry tonight: whoever gets home first visits the other's family. They shook on it.
The pump's fault proved to be a worn fitting. Zeno Edge made a replacement from scrap while the men returned to bailing by hand.
A bullet went through Zeno Edge's sleeve at Q-F22 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Viktor Ghost of the Hegemony (@gaunt_ghost_611).
Zeno Edge is fit for duty again. He celebrated by sleeping a whole afternoon before anyone noticed.
nordmann_i_viking: Norbert "Hollow" Viking, a postman from Saint-Lune, was sent forward on Day 9 to fill a gap in Q-F14. The gap had a name once. Nobody says it.

Norbert "Hollow" Viking saw a helmet rise behind the enemy sandbags at Q-F14 and fired once. Bastian "Button" Kibtenkibby was grazed. Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Norbert "Hollow" Viking kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.

Norbert "Hollow" Viking spent an hour repairing a pocket. Nothing goes in it now without a careful inspection. The Hegemony won Grey Mill. In Q-F14, Norbert "Hollow" Viking listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.
Fresh from training, Norbert "Hollow" Viking still aims the way the instructor said. Today it worked: Ulrich Felix, badly wounded.
Norbert "Hollow" Viking watched fog gather on the wire until every strand carried beads of water. The sentry beside him called it expensive fencing.
Norbert "Hollow" Viking spent the night filling sandbags. By dawn he could no longer close his hands. By noon the shells had emptied half of them again.
A periscope poked up from the enemy line. Norbert "Hollow" Viking shot it to pieces, and the man holding it, Felix Luccisan, was badly wounded.
Part of the parapet collapsed near Norbert "Hollow" Viking. Repairs started as soon as the dust settled, with one man on watch while the rest worked.
Norbert "Hollow" Viking and Norbert "Parson" Alvacatraska cooked a stew from everything in their pockets: one onion, two biscuits and a button. They ate all of it except the button.
rboir6: On Day 4 Rafael Rboir took a post at S-F4 that had been empty for two nights. He did not ask why. He draws portraits of the men in the margins of letters, and the men liked him for it.
At Saint-Ash crossroads, Rafael Rboir and Teodor Roos exchanged rifle shots until a shell burst between the positions. For a while, both rifles remained silent.

Rafael Rboir and Emil "Saint" Projectpuffy carved a chessboard into an ammunition box. The pieces are bullets, buttons and one very patient beetle. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Hill 304. Rafael Rboir read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.
A bullet clipped Rafael Rboir's helmet at S-F4 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Oskar Perry of the Hegemony (@bo.perry._).
The medics cleaned Rafael Rboir's wound one last time and pronounced him fit. He is back to full duty at S-F4.
The bread was divided with a ruler. Rafael Rboir received the smallest piece and the job of looking after the ruler.
Rafael Rboir's spoon vanished during supper. He scratched a mark into a replacement and began keeping a closer eye on the washing bucket.
Day 10: Blackwater Canal was lost. Rafael Rboir wrote down the news without trying to explain it.

A second spoon disappeared. Rafael Rboir searched the washing area and found a gap behind the board where everyone left cutlery to dry. The clerk counted the names twice. Rafael Rboir is number 285 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. News of the loss of Grey Mill reached S-F4 with the rations. Rafael Rboir ate while listening to the revised orders.
The relief reached S-F4 without Rafael Rboir. His name was added to a list the corporal kept separate from the dead.
Nobody at S-F4 has seen Rafael Rboir since the last patrol. His bunk is still made.
The sentry nearly shot Rafael Rboir coming in through the wire. He had been lost near Verdel Ridge for two days, living on puddle water and stubbornness.
Rafael Rboir lifted the board. The gap contained seven spoons, a button and a pencil people had blamed the quartermaster for losing.

The raiders came over the parapet in the dark. Rafael Rboir was hit hard in the fight at S-F4 before anyone could fire. The raider was Bastian "Shadow" Grantcsst of the Hegemony. Raider: Bastian "Shadow" Grantcsst of the Hegemony (@grantcsst).
Rafael Rboir rejoined the squad at S-F4. Someone had written his name on the wall with 'still alive' under it. He left it there.
realshayanworld: Wendel Realshayanwo arrived with the Day 9 draft, carrying a bullet that missed him and the news from home, which was old by the time he told it. Wendel Realshayanwo's transfer to the role of rifleman was approved. The quartermaster wanted every borrowed item back before issuing anything else.

Wendel Realshayanwo joined the raid, lay in a shell hole for an hour while the flares burned, and made it home. That counts as a good night out here. Victory at Blackwater Canal. Wendel Realshayanwo let himself talk about leave for the first time in days. A letter from home reached Wendel Realshayanwo before dusk. Wendel Realshayanwo read it twice and slept a little easier.

Wendel Realshayanwo received the rank of Lance Corporal and a stack of unfinished paperwork. The congratulations lasted less time than the paperwork. A letter from home reached Wendel Realshayanwo before dusk. Wendel Realshayanwo read it twice and slept a little easier. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Wendel Realshayanwo is number 660. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. Wendel Realshayanwo walked the captured trenches of Grey Mill and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.

Wendel Realshayanwo and Jonas "Button" Eventhatoneg spent an hour hunting rats with a bucket and a piece of cheese. Score at dusk: rats 4, soldiers 1. A letter from home reached Wendel Realshayanwo before dusk. Wendel Realshayanwo read it twice and slept a little easier.
Wendel Realshayanwo borrowed a serial novel from a newspaper bundle. The instalment ends with a locked door and a pistol shot. The next issue is missing.

Wendel Realshayanwo has fired hundreds of rounds into the dark. Today one of them found someone: Wendel "Bones" Schildbroete, grazed. A letter from home reached Wendel Realshayanwo before dusk. Wendel Realshayanwo read it twice and slept a little easier.

The enemy post had been quiet all morning. Wendel Realshayanwo waited for that to change. When it did, Leopold "Whistle" Kagr was gravely wounded. Wendel Realshayanwo fired at the flash of a shovel across the wire. Behind the shovel was Albin "Hollow" Guyy, now grazed. A letter from home reached Wendel Realshayanwo before dusk. Wendel Realshayanwo read it twice and slept a little easier.

Wendel Realshayanwo has asked three carrying parties for the next instalment. So far, the search has produced racing results and an advertisement for boots. Now serving as a sniper, Wendel Realshayanwo discovered that being experienced at the front did not prevent being new at the job.
Wendel Realshayanwo noticed a loophole that had been dark for days. He watched it until dusk and wrote down what changed.
redactedwords3985: Bram Redactedword arrived on Day 10 and found the section asleep. The welcome had to wait until somebody needed the kettle. The snipers took Bram Redactedword in on a busy morning in Q-F16. By noon he had learned the first rule of the job, and by evening the second.

Bram Redactedword had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Silas Chaser crossed it, Bram Redactedword fired. Silas Chaser was badly wounded. A letter from home found Bram Redactedword before the night shift. Bram Redactedword folded it small and kept it close. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Bram Redactedword watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.

Bram Redactedword fired, worked the bolt, and fired again. Across the wire, Severin "Owl" Taylocirapto was gravely wounded. Bram Redactedword ate breakfast without a word. A letter from home found Bram Redactedword before the night shift. Bram Redactedword folded it small and kept it close.

Bram Redactedword noticed a loophole that had been dark for days. He watched it until dusk and wrote down what changed. A letter from home found Bram Redactedword before the night shift. Bram Redactedword folded it small and kept it close.

Bram Redactedword borrowed a book with three readers already waiting in line. For once, everyone was impatient about something harmless. A letter from home found Bram Redactedword before the night shift. Bram Redactedword folded it small and kept it close.

Leopold Cbr fell asleep on watch. Bram Redactedword took over without waking Leopold, and told the sergeant nothing. A letter from home found Bram Redactedword before the night shift. Bram Redactedword folded it small and kept it close.

Bram Redactedword was on watch at Q-F16 when the night raid hit. The men found Bram Redactedword at dawn by the dugout door. Killed in the night raid by Nils Francescsequ of the Concord (@francescsequera_).
The papers say Clement Redactedword. The sergeant says he has his cousin's eyes. Bram Redactedword's eyes. Nobody in Q-F16 argues.

Clement Redactedword's spoon vanished during supper. He scratched a mark into a replacement and began keeping a closer eye on the washing bucket. The letter for Clement Redactedword was mostly about the weather at home. Clement Redactedword read that part twice too.
simsnichols: On Day 14 Tobias "Ash" Simsnichols took a post at N-F7 that had been empty for two nights. He did not ask why. He never sits with his back to the parapet, and the men liked him for it.

Face blackened with soot, Tobias "Ash" Simsnichols spent the night in a shell hole out in front of the wire. At first light Cyril "Tin" Camiloalmada was grazed. Mail came up the line with a letter for Tobias "Ash" Simsnichols. Tobias "Ash" Simsnichols read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Tobias "Ash" Simsnichols was on the dawn watch at N-F7 when the Concord raiders came. A club, a shout, and Tobias "Ash" Simsnichols was on the trench floor waiting for the medic. Raider: Nils Mcwillzz of the Concord (@mcwillzz). Tobias "Ash" Simsnichols asked the bearers for water and then for his mother. He died before either came.
Jonas "Rabbit" Simsnichols joined N-F7 under the shadow of Tobias "Ash" Simsnichols's name. At the first roll call, the corporal used the right one.

Jonas "Rabbit" Simsnichols wrote a letter home. He wrote about the weather. He did not write about the rats. A letter came for Jonas "Rabbit" Simsnichols with a ribbon tied around it. Jonas "Rabbit" Simsnichols kept the ribbon in a tunic pocket.
somosmagios.bo: Nobody asked Edmund Somosmagios why he came. Nobody in S-F9 asks that. He was handed a spade before he was handed a rifle.
Edmund Somosmagios was among the first hundred through the depot gates. The First Wave ribbon is the only clean thing he owns.
Edmund Somosmagios and Anselm Tom compared drawings of home. Both drawings included a kitchen table larger than the house.
The Concord took Verdel Ridge. Edmund Somosmagios watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.
A single shot from across the wire hit Edmund Somosmagios in the thigh at S-F9. He crawled the last yards on his elbows. Shot by Isidor Jackmdunn of the Concord (@jackmdunn06).
Edmund Somosmagios drifted in and out on the stretcher. Every time he woke, the line for the beds seemed longer.

There was never a bed for Edmund Somosmagios, so the medics brought the hospital to him. Three days on a stretcher, and he walked back to S-F9 on his own feet. The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Hill 304. Edmund Somosmagios folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.

A burst of machine-gun fire caught Edmund Somosmagios in the open at S-F9. The tourniquet held. Whether he holds is another matter. Shot by Yann Vee of the Concord (@ask._.vee). An orderly waved the bearers in: one bed, cleared and scrubbed. Edmund Somosmagios was lifted onto it in the hospital dugout. The surgeon worked on Edmund Somosmagios until the lamp ran dry. It was not enough.

Benedikt "Saint" Somosmagios came to the front because his older brother Edmund Somosmagios never came home. He carries a lucky button. Benedikt "Saint" Somosmagios, volunteer number 63, received the First Wave ribbon. The quartermaster pronounced the name wrong; he corrected it for the record.
Benedikt "Saint" Somosmagios and Arno Toastyy made a pact on sentry tonight: whoever gets home first visits the other's family. They shook on it.
A bullet bounced off the trench wall and caught Benedikt "Saint" Somosmagios across the shin at S-F9. It bled a lot and meant very little. Shot by Yann Vee of the Concord (@ask._.vee).

A bullet hit Benedikt "Saint" Somosmagios in the back as he turned to pass ammunition along at S-F9. He went down on the duckboards and the men shouted for the bearers. Shot by Yann Vee of the Concord (@ask._.vee). Benedikt "Saint" Somosmagios was killed at S-F9 just after dawn. The cup of tea beside him was still hot. Shot by Yann Vee of the Concord (@ask._.vee).

Yann Somosmagios joined S-F9 under the shadow of Benedikt "Saint" Somosmagios's name. At the first roll call, the corporal used the right one. Number 63 on the early rolls: Yann Somosmagios. The First Wave ribbon arrived with instructions about where to sew it and no needle.

A bullet hit the sandbag next to Yann Somosmagios's ear at S-F9 and sprayed his face with grit and blood. A scratch, the medic said, and a lucky one. Shot by Jakub "Whistle" Sergio of the Concord (@micro_sergio). Yann Somosmagios walked the captured trenches of Blackwater Canal and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.

Yann Somosmagios's wound has closed. He showed the scar to everyone at S-F9 until the sergeant told him to put his shirt back on. Day 11. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. From the heights Yann Somosmagios could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.
The enemy post had been quiet all morning. Yann Somosmagios waited for that to change. When it did, Walter "Hollow" Leuttne was grazed.
The gun at S-F9 jammed twice and fired once. Once was enough: Walter Maccario, grazed.

Brass cases piled up around Yann Somosmagios's boots at S-F9. Out of all those rounds, one found Marek Jackmdunn, grazed. A sniper's bullet hit Yann Somosmagios at S-F9. The medics worked on him in the bottom of the trench and shouted for a stretcher. Shot by Yann Vee of the Concord (@ask._.vee). Yann Somosmagios was killed at S-F9 while passing a message along the trench. He never finished the sentence. Shot by Yann Vee of the Concord (@ask._.vee).
The House of Somosmagios sent Bram Somosmagios after Yann Somosmagios. This time the family packed two pairs of spare socks.
A round went through Bram Somosmagios's water bottle and into his thigh, but not far. He is more upset about the water. Shot by Marek Man of the Concord (@to_man58).
Bram Somosmagios is fit for duty again. He celebrated by sleeping a whole afternoon before anyone noticed.
A bullet hit Bram Somosmagios's belt buckle at S-F9 and glanced off into his side. Shallow, the medic said. He is keeping the buckle. Shot by Roland Rry of the Concord (@c10ud_b3rry3.0).
theteeternotharis: The draft reached P-F17 on Day 11. Emil "Ash" Theteeternot was shown which board tipped, which roof leaked and which promises to ignore. Emil "Ash" Theteeternot walked the captured trenches of Grey Mill and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.
Emil "Ash" Theteeternot reached up to fix a sandbag at P-F17 and a bullet took the skin off two knuckles. The sandbag got fixed anyway. Shot by Lucien Curi of the Concord (@iago_curi).

Emil "Ash" Theteeternot was hit in the knee while crossing a low part of the trench at P-F17. He will walk again, the medic thinks, but not soon. Shot by Ulrich Tylerbec of the Concord (@tylerbec13). Emil "Ash" Theteeternot was killed at P-F17 just after dawn. The cup of tea beside him was still hot. Shot by Ulrich Tylerbec of the Concord (@tylerbec13).
The papers say Lucien "Hollow" Theteeternot. The sergeant says he has his uncle's eyes. Emil "Ash" Theteeternot's eyes. Nobody in P-F17 argues.
Across from P-F17, an enemy soldier stood up to stretch. Lucien "Hollow" Theteeternot saw it. Quentin "Brick" Jadenmurff was grazed.
The gun at P-F17 jammed twice and fired once. Once was enough: Tobias Olly, badly wounded.
Lucien "Hollow" Theteeternot and Jonas "Saint" Carrsonhartw found a cat in the ruins at the Chalk Pits and argued for an hour about its name. The cat settled it by sleeping on Saint.
Lucien "Hollow" Theteeternot polished a spoon until he could see a small, bent version of his face. It looked unimpressed with supper too.
ty_m1015: The old hands of S-R3 have been here since Day 1. Ulrich Tym has been here since Day 9. In a trench, that difference already feels like years.

Ulrich Tym saw the glint of an enemy scope and fired first. The man behind it, Norbert Cipowski, was grazed. Word came down the line: Blackwater Canal is ours. Ulrich Tym shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.

Ulrich Tym wrote the range on the back of a ration card: 380 yards. Then Ulrich Tym used it. Zeno "Brick" Peter was grazed. Victory at Grey Mill. Ulrich Tym let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.
A story about a goat passed through three dugouts and reached Ulrich Tym as a story about a general. The ending was the same.
Ulrich Tym fired at the enemy dawn watch from S-R3. Anselm "Tin" Belugawales was badly wounded, and the enemy line spent the morning with its heads down.
A bullet hit Ulrich Tym's belt buckle at S-R3 and glanced off into his side. Shallow, the medic said. He is keeping the buckle. Shot by Leopold Falloutcat of the Concord (@falloutcat123).
Stitches out, sleeve rolled down. Ulrich Tym is whole again, or near enough for the line.
The kettle lid rattled whenever the conversation stopped. Ulrich Tym put a folded cloth beneath it and immediately missed the noise.
Ulrich Tym let the enemy fix the same sandbag three times. The fourth time, Marek Janzhhhhhhhh was gravely wounded.
